text:
She who sleeps there, the sacred one,
who kisses me and knows me,
the translucent, the vibrant,
the one mad
with love, the high
zither:

you,

no one
but, supple,
you,
the lofty one,
in the high air
of the original
oil
of the Species:

you,

she who spins
at the blind
speed
of the sun:

you,

the elegance
of your natural
presence
so close,
my slope
of diamond, my
harp,
so wondrously mine:

you,

paradise
or
no one,
a string
for hearing
the wind
above the stellar
abyss:

you,

a page
of skin beyond
the air:

you,

hands
I loved,
bare
feet
of the ivory
rhythm
where I placed
my kisses:

you,

volcano
and petals,
flame;
living
tongue
of love:

you,

splendid
figure, orchid
whose airy nature
allows me
to fly:

you,

mortal
girl, fragrance
of another music
of snow,
stealthily
Andean:

you,

daughter of the open,
golden
sea,
you who dance
motionless,
standing
there
in transparency
from
the depths
of the beginning:

you,

mountain range, you,
sleepwalking
chrysalis
in the intangible
radiance
of your corolla:

you,

no one: you:

You,
Poetry,
you,
Spirit,
no one:

you,

who blow
into the wind
these
dark
vowels,
these
measured
chords
in the riddle
of the earthly:

you.

translation.title: She Who Sleeps There, the Sacred One...
